sources.entry: NewsBlur - Personal news reader that brings people together to talk about the world. A new sound of an old instrument. (Source Code) MIT Python

summary.one_liner: NewsBlur is a self-hostable personal RSS news reader and social news network built on Django, with trainable filters that highlight or hide stories.
summary.what_it_does: NewsBlur is an RSS feed reader that shows each site's original page and lets you train filters (classifiers) on authors, tags, titles, and feeds to highlight or hide stories. It includes full-text search across subscriptions, story tagging, saved searches, and shared stories on a public or private blurblog. It can expand truncated feeds to the full article, track how a story changed after publication, and follow YouTube channels and email newsletters. The repository runs a full self-hosted instance via Docker Compose, with a Django and Backbone.js stack backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and optional Elasticsearch. The README also describes an MCP server that lets AI agents read feeds and manage subscriptions, which requires a premium account.
use_cases: read news feeds with filtering and training
follow YouTube channels or newsletters in a feed reader
connect AI agents to RSS subscriptions
how_to_run: Visit the local URL shown in the README (accept the self-signed certificate warning)
docker exec -t newsblur_web python manage.py bootstrap_popular_feeds --skip-fetch
notable: Trainable classifiers that automatically highlight or hide stories
Original site view and full-text expansion of truncated feeds
MCP server for connecting AI agents to feeds and classifiers
Git worktree support with per-worktree ports for parallel development
caveats: The MCP server requires a premium NewsBlur subscription
Self-hosted setup depends on Docker and multiple databases and services (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
Hosted newsblur.com free tier is limited to 64 sites and premium plans are paid
